snapshot.title: Watch .underdraw/ for outside changes
snapshot.description:
The daemon watches `.underdraw/` with fsnotify and reloads on outside changes: hand edits, `git pull`, branch switches and merges. Deferred from step 2, where files load only at startup.

Requirements.md, Architecture → Daemon: rebuild the index, bump revisions and push updates; report invalid files without crashing.

Related history types: `CHANGE_TYPE_EXTERNAL_EDIT` with actor `ACTOR_TYPE_EXTERNAL`, and the ChangeEvent note about recording a merged result as a new revision.
